copied: // 文件标题放在比例区域外。

<Drawer open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}
  swipeDirection="right" modal={false} disablePointerDismissal>
  <TaskList onView={task => { setCurrentTask(task); setOpen(true); }} />
  <DrawerContent><DrawerHeader className="flex-row items-start justify-between"><DrawerTitle>{currentTask.title}</DrawerTitle>
    <DrawerClose render={<IconButton icon={<CloseIcon />} aria-label="关闭任务详情" />} />
    </DrawerHeader><DrawerBody>{content}</DrawerBody>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>

<FormItem label="课堂验证码" status={error ? "error" : "default"} message={error}>
  <InputOTP name="classroomCode" maxLength={6} value={code} onChange={setCode}
    pattern={"^\\d+$"} onComplete={() => setLengthComplete(true)}>
    <InputOTPGroup>{[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(index => <InputOTPSlot key={index} index={index} />)}</InputOTPGroup>
  </InputOTP>
</FormItem>
// form onSubmit读取FormData，显式验证；onComplete不自动提交。

<Carousel aria-label="本周精选" tabIndex={0} opts={{ align: "start" }}>
  <CarouselContent>{courses.map(course =>
    <CarouselItem key={course.title} aria-label={course.title}>{/* 专题内容 */}</CarouselItem>
  )}</CarouselContent>
  <CarouselControls layout="inline" indicatorPlacement="bottom">
    <CarouselPrevious /><CarouselIndicators /><CarouselNext />
  </CarouselControls>
</Carousel>
// 显式自动播放：playback={{ mode: "autoplay", delay: 5000, direction: "forward" }}
// 连续播放：playback={{ mode: "continuous", speed: 36, direction: "reverse" }}
// 覆盖式 Controls 的 height/style 指向实际媒体安全区；业务内容留在宿主。

const items=[{name:"goal",required:true,choices:[{value:"review"}]},{name:"note"}];
<Questionnaire items={items} onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault(); save(new FormData(e.currentTarget));}}>
 <QuestionnaireProgress /><QuestionnaireItem name="goal" required><QuestionnaireTitle>学习目标</QuestionnaireTitle><QuestionnaireChoice value="review">复习</QuestionnaireChoice><QuestionnaireError /></QuestionnaireItem>
 <QuestionnaireItem name="note"><QuestionnaireTitle>补充</QuestionnaireTitle><QuestionnaireInput aria-label="补充说明" /></QuestionnaireItem>
 <QuestionnaireActions><QuestionnairePrevious /><QuestionnaireSkip /><QuestionnaireNext /><QuestionnaireSubmit /></QuestionnaireActions>
</Questionnaire>
